title: All five presets, one seed, one camera
question: Top to bottom: arid, canyon, rolling, terraced, wetland — every generated preset the engine ships, same seed, same camera, same hour. How many distinguishable kinds of country do you count?
context_md:
The control card for 'Two different presets, one country'. Measured over the same renders: **arid and wetland sit 0.711 apart, rolling and terraced 0.149** — so if the numbers match your eye, the top and bottom should read as different places and the middle three should collapse into one.

What I am after is a count, not a preference. If the answer is 'two or three', that sizes the revamp: five presets are shipping as two or three places.

Note what is *not* in any of these: a green pixel. Vegetation is 0.02% of the visible cells at generation, and switching the whole planting pass off changes 343 pixels out of 2.6 million.

items.label: arid / canyon / rolling / terraced / wetland, seed 1
items.caption: top to bottom, in that order
